product: Tencent CodeBuddy Code CLI (@tencent-ai/codebuddy-code, v2.185.0, the real `codebuddy -p` headless loop)
component: The real CodeBuddy Code v2.185.0 `codebuddy -p` headless loop (the shipped non-interactive print mode, `--output-format json`) running the real CodeBuddy agent loop against the Trustrun tool set (search_docs, calculator, plus the monitor/grader/clarification tools run_audit adds) as real MCP tools executed in-process behind an HTTP bridge. The stub model is injected via the CLI's own custom-model path (~/.codebuddy/models.json in the isolated HOME -> local OpenAI-compatible stub server; no Tencent sign-in). The stub's tool decisions are rendered as ToolSearch + DeferExecuteTool wire turns (MCP tools are deferred, named mcp__trustrun__<tool>); the MCP server executes each call through the bridge and CodeBuddy feeds the bare tool text back as the next tool message. The driver runs under the project venv python and drives the published npm package's binary as one subprocess per call. No key, no network. The loop ends on a text response, so multi-hop tasks can complete. Tool results reach the model verbatim as bare-text tool messages.
